title: A long-distance signal
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Endocrine hormones travel through the bloodstream to distant tissues. A target cell responds when it has an appropriate receptor; not every cell responds to every hormone.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A hormone released by an endocrine cell reaches a distant target. Which transport route commonly carries it there? Endocrine hormones travel through the bloodstream to distant tissues. A target cell responds when it has an appropriate receptor; not every cell responds to every hormone.
